preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 100,000.
Number of provinces is between 2 and 200,000.
Number of destroyed roads is between 0 and the minimum of N*(N-1)/2 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: u != v for all (u, v) in destroyed_roads
preconditions.description: No road connects a province to itself.

preconditions.expression: all(u > 0 and u <= N and v > 0 and v <= N for (u, v) in destroyed_roads)
preconditions.description: All provinces in the destroyed roads are within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The output is a list of the number of ways to deploy the senas for each test case.
The number of ways to deploy the senas is non-negative.
